subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Why Mobile Testing Is Different
description: A fast breakdown of Why Mobile Testing Is Different for builders.

hook.text: A website works perfectly on desktop. On a phone, buttons overlap, text truncates, and the form won't submit.

buildup.text: Mobile devices vary in screen size, OS version, hardware power, and network conditions.

discovery.text: Desktop testing assumes a stable environment. Mobile testing must handle extreme variability.

twist.text: Over 60% of web traffic comes from mobile. Ignoring mobile testing means ignoring most of your users.

climax.text: A team adds mobile testing. User complaints drop by 45% in the first quarter.

punchline.text: Mobile is the majority. Test where your users actually are.

quiz.question: Why is mobile testing more complex than desktop testing?
options: Devices vary in screen size, OS, hardware, and network
